cases.sql: SELECT d.g,SUM(f.n),SUM(f.c),SUM(f.s) FROM (SELECT k,COUNT(*) AS n,COUNT(v) AS c,SUM(v) AS s FROM facts GROUP BY k) f JOIN (SELECT k,g FROM facts WHERE id < 512 AND MOD(id,7) <> 0) d ON f.k=d.k GROUP BY d.g ORDER BY d.g
